blocks.text: Recognize a potentially difficult airway before induction and work through a backup plan when the first approach fails.
Agreeing a primary and backup plan with the attending and surgeon
Checking that backup equipment is at the bedside

Row | Content
Procedure | Knee Arthroscopy
Patient summary | Woman with long-standing rheumatoid arthritis. Limited neck mobility — neck pain with any extension.
Critical event | Difficult laryngoscopy with limited neck mobility requiring in-line stabilization.
Primary learning objectives | Perform a focused airway exam; gather prior records and the surgeon's view; keep the head neutral during laryngoscopy
